title: TRAINEE/JUNIOR IRRIGATION DESIGNER
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Irrigation Designer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Do you have experience using AutoCAD 2D?
rationale: Trainee/junior irrigation designer role at a direct Perth consultancy that trains the hire toward Certified Irrigation Designer; it asks for recent AutoCAD experience, a driver's licence and working rights, all of which Marc has.
His Advanced Diploma stormwater drainage design and AutoCAD and Civil 3D drawing work, plus drawing review and site inspections in the Philippines, fit the design support and site visit duties.
Irrigation design is a specialist niche and the role is in Perth; Marc has no irrigation experience and relocation needs his confirmation.
caution: Perth role, relocation from Melton needs Marc's confirmation (Cadsult also has a Melbourne office in Fairfield, but the advert is for the Perth team). No irrigation design experience; AutoCAD experience is from study.
gaps: No irrigation or landscape water design experience
AutoCAD experience is from Advanced Diploma coursework, not a paid drafting role
Not based in Perth; relocation not yet confirmed by Marc
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (no link out). SEEK questions: right to work, years as an irrigation designer, notice period, current Australian driver's licence, AutoCAD 2D experience.
